messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the GPU surge postmortem  consolidating owners and timelines. please claim.

maya: ACTIONS:
1) quota buffer -> set default project buffer to 15% (owner: alex)  reduce sudden OOM evictions
2) scheduler knobs -> test adaptive packing start=0.66, min=0.6 (owner: sam)
3) headroom sim -> 48h soak + injected spikes (owner: jin)
4) canary plan -> 30m smoke, 2h soak, 6h full canary; auto-rollback hook (owner: ops-bot + maya)
5) runbook/alerts -> add "surge aftercare" page + new alert for quota_breach_rate>2/min (owner: maya)

maya: timeline: PRs by Wed EOD, sim Thu-Fri, canary next Mon; full rollout after clean canary + 5d observation.

alex: i'll own quota changes and guardrails. will open PR today.

sam: adaptive packing OK, will run perf vs cost sweep. note: lowering packing can increase infra spend.

jin: need traces. maya please post S3 path and i'll kick off the sim.

maya: s3://redwood-incidents/surge-traces/2026-03-v3.tar.gz  anonymized 5-day peak window.

ops-bot: ci: quota-buffer PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4333

alex: PR up, includes feature flag and tests. request reviews from infra.

sam: perf sweep scheduled: packing=[0.62,0.66,0.7], preempt_backoff=[300,800] run 3h each. will post matrix.

jin: sim started on dev-grid. uploading to /sim-results/3298765432.tar.gz. initial 12h: buffer cut eviction tail ~72%, p99 up ~3% on worst-case.

maya: proposed canary abort: eviction_rate>1/min OR p99 uplift>10% OR cost_delta>9%.

ops-bot: canary-runner: started canary on prod-canary-4 (id: cr-3298765432).

alex: monitoring dashboards. smoke stage: clean. moving to soak.

ops-bot: canary: full stage complete  result=PASS. metrics: eviction_rate=0, p99+2.3%, cost_delta+4.1%.

maya: thanks. next steps: alex merge after 2 approvals, sam finalize knob rec, jin post full sim report, and i'll update runbook and create closure ticket.

alex: merging now.

sam: will post final numbers by EOD. leaning toward adaptive start=0.66, min=0.6 with cost_guard=6%.

jin: report uploaded: https://drive.redwood/sim-reports/3298765432-summary.pdf  recommend canary config above.

maya: scheduling 15-min pulse checks Mon/Tue while we watch. if clean, i'll close actions in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
